configfile.description: Path to the minidlna configuration file.

logfile.description: Path to the minidlna log file.

user.description: User the daemon should run as (sysV init only; systemd uses unit override).

group.description: Group the daemon should run as (sysV init only; systemd uses unit override).

daemon_opts.description: Additional options passed to the minidlna daemon (e.g., '-r' for soft rebuild on startup).

friendly_name.description: Name of the DLNA/UPnP server as advertised on the network.

interface.description: Network interface to bind to (e.g., 'eth0'); leave empty to bind to all interfaces.

http_port.description: TCP port for HTTP media streaming and web UI (if enabled).

ssdp_port.description: UDP port for SSDP/UPnP discovery announcements.

media_dirs.description: List of media directories (path and optional friendly name).

media_dirs.*.path.description: Absolute path to a media directory (must be readable by minidlna user).

media_dirs.*.name.description: Friendly name for this directory (shown in UPnP browser); leave blank to use path basename.

db_dir.description: Directory to store the metadata database and thumbnail cache.

log_dir.description: Directory to store runtime log files.

uuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for the server. Leave empty to auto-generate.

root_container.description: Root container to display at top level: '.' (root), 'F' (filesystem), 'M' (music), 'V' (video), 'P' (pictures).

inotify.description: Enable inotify-based automatic updates when media files change.

strict_dlna.description: Enable strict DLNA compliance (disables some non-standard but widely used features).

enable_transcoding.description: Enable external transcoding (requires transcoding_cmd to be set).

transcoding_cmd.description: Command to invoke for audio/video transcoding (e.g., '/usr/bin/ffmpeg -i %s -f mp3 -').

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

model_name.description: Model name advertised in UPnP device description.

model_number.description: Model number advertised in UPnP device description.

serial_number.description: Serial number advertised in UPnP device description.

friendly_name_model.description: Friendly description for UPnP device category (e.g., 'Digital Media Server').

album_art_names.description: List of filenames to recognize as album art (case-insensitive).

enable_upnp.description: Enable UPnP server advertisement via SSDP.

presentation_url.description: URL to a web UI for management (e.g., '/'). Leave blank to omit.

cache_dir.description: Directory for temporary cache (e.g., thumbnail cache). Leave empty to use db_dir.
